name: dopamine-readme
description: Switches on product-showcase README mode — turning dry technical walls of text, flat feature lists, and boilerplate docs into vivid, high-craft GitHub storefronts that earn a star within the first 5 seconds of scrolling. Brings editorial pacing, playful visuals seamlessly woven into Markdown, dark/light theme parity, ruthless priority ladders, human-first explanations without source-code clutter, and bold Before -> After numbers. Activate when creating, rewriting, redesigning, or auditing README.md and README.*.md, and on triggers: "dopamine-readme", "dopamine readme", "rewrite README", "redesign README", "make README pop", "audit README".
